# Synthetic sample data

**Every file in this folder is synthetic.** The data was generated by
[`scripts/generate_sample_data.py`](../../../scripts/generate_sample_data.py) with a fixed
random seed. It does not come from any real market, exchange or data vendor. The companies,
symbols (`SYN-*`) and the `DEMO` exchange are made up. Any resemblance to real companies is
coincidental.

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `base/` | 6 securities and 1,566 daily bars (Monday-Friday, 2024-01-02 to 2024-12-31) |
| `update/` | A follow-up batch for testing the pipeline: 35 new bars (2025-01-02 to 2025-01-08, including a new security `SYN-GLC`), 1 correction to an already-loaded day, 3 invalid rows and 1 duplicate row |

Prices follow a geometric random walk. Exchange holidays are not modelled.

Regenerate the files (the output is identical every time):

```bash
python scripts/generate_sample_data.py
```
